title: Bazel Native Toolchain Classes
description: 🧰️ Declares which tasks the Bazel adapter keys by the identity of a native toolchain: a task is a member when its tool family is the named one or its command runs the named driver. Go and Cargo keep their own identities; every class here digests the pins of the neutral toolchain contract, so Nx and Bazel key the same work the same way.
